about: Attacks an enemy lord or army; if it slips out of view, goes to where it was last seen. It gives up a chase that has not closed in for 8 hours (a target as fast as the lord is caught only when it stops), and an attack that would be lost: once the enemies who could be in the fight by its middle or its end (the march to it and the battle's own hours, by the game's rules) are give_up_odds times your side there (weighed from its second hour on, so the other lords sent at the same target in the same answer count with it). Its next order, if any, starts.

give_up_odds: break off once the enemies who could be in the fight by its middle or its end are this many times your side's strength there (10: never)

when.poke: {target} is gone (beaten, captured or broken up).

when.if: not in_battle and hours_running >= 1 and fight_odds(target) > give_up_odds
when.poke: {me} broke off the attack on {target}: the enemies who could be in the fight by its middle or its end are {round(fight_odds(target) * 100)}% of your side's {side_strength(target)}.
{me} gave up the chase of {target}: no closer in 8 hours ({distance(me, target)} away), so {target} is as fast as {me} or faster.

search.about: looking for {target} where it was last seen

when.poke: {target} is gone (beaten, captured or broken up).
